items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I worked on the boat with Eddie Allen.

ctx.x: And then what did you do in Rock Island, Illinois?

Pick up the steam of St. Paul. Oh. Got on the steam of St. Paul. Then we got in there the 5th of May. Is it the Mississippi River still? Yeah. Then we went up the, we cruised up the river playing every night on the boat, further to Buick Highway, see. Then we come on back down the river, and we had to be in St. Louis for the 34th of May. The 34th of May is a big day in St. Louis, see. Then we run out of St. Louis every night on the steam of St. Paul. Now they had two bands on that boat. They had a band on the day…

items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Then Eddie Allen's got the band, they call it the Gold Whispin' Band, see.

ctx.x: Yeah, I know Baby told me that you got him on the job.

I got Baby Dots, see. So we was getting around the end of the season we wanted another trumpet player. So Louie was playing with the O-Rey band down on Claiborne Street. Pete Laudas had a little dance hall. So I carried Johnny Strick was down there and enlisted Louie. He wanted Louie. And Louie come on the boat. So Louie moves music that he learned, he should give Joe Howard, the trumpet player, very good trumpet player. He's from up around St. John's, Louisiana. Him from St. John's, Louisiana. John Robichaud,…
